name: Université Grenoble Alpes
summary: Large research university in Grenoble, ringed by the Alps; licences are taught in French, with bilingual international tracks in maths and physics.

ib.text: EU/EEA nationals apply to a first-year licence through Parcoursup. Licences are in French; the international tracks teach much of the science in English.

lastYear.text: wishes 19 January–12 March; confirm by 1 April

notes: Years 1–2 of the maths–computer science and physics–chemistry–mechanics licences have international tracks, taught in English and French and selected on science and English.
UGA's English-taught bachelor-level entries otherwise start in year 3 (management, managerial economics, nuclear engineering).
